Question B-001-015-009.

Why the correct answer is right: The 15-metre amateur band range in the official answer is 21.000 MHz to 21.450 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "18.068 MHz to 18.168 MHz": 18.068 MHz to 18.168 MHz names a different HF allocation, not the 15-metre range.
- sourceIndex 2: "14.000 MHz to 14.350 MHz": 14.000 MHz to 14.350 MHz is the 20-metre range, not 15 metres.
- sourceIndex 3: "28.000 MHz to 29.700 MHz": 28.000 MHz to 29.700 MHz is the 10-metre range in the bank.
